subject: Recap + Proposed 4-week POC sprint & OKR-focused success criteria — EmeraldAI
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@emeraldai.com>, procurement@emeraldai.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 13:03:00 -0400
Subject: Recap + Proposed 4-week POC sprint & OKR-focused success criteria — EmeraldAI

Hi Liam / Emerald AI team,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today — really appreciate the candid discussion about the three primary use cases and the volume profile you shared. As promised, attached is a concise POC proposal outlining a 4-week sprint targeted at the search + summarization workflow we walked through. High-level recap and asks below.

Quick recap of the demo:
- Goal: reduce time-to-answer for customer support agents by surfacing concise, context-aware summaries from ticket history.
- Demonstrated flow: Redwood hosted model (opt-13b-quant) -> prefix caching for recent tickets -> structured JSON output with confidence score.

Proposed 4-week POC sprint (high level):
Week 0 (prep): data access + brief security review (3 business days)
Week 1: integration + sample ingestion (connect S3 or secure FTPS)
Week 2: functional validation (50 representative threads) + metric collection
Week 3: blind eval + user acceptance with two agent testers
Week 4: analysis, threshold tuning, success review and wrap 

Success criteria (OKR-style, please confirm):
- Accuracy: 80%+ NDCG@5 on prioritized intents (internal eval set)
- Latency: 95th percentile response under 1.2s for 80-token outputs
- Usability: >= 4/5 average rating from agent usability survey (n=10)
- Cost: projected token spend <= $X (will provide estimate once we confirm ingestion size)

Owners / points of contact:
- Redwood integration: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.com) — infra & ingestion
- Evaluation & metrics: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.com) — eval scripts and dashboard
- Commercial / scheduling: Mina Haddad (mina.haddad@redwood.com)

What we need from Emerald AI to start:
1) Access to a sample bucket (S3 path or secure transfer) with 500–1,000 anonymized tickets (JSON or CSV)
2) Confirm which agent workflows to prioritize (Support - Tier 1 / Billing / Onboarding)
3) Procurement contact for SOW / PO + any IP or security redlines (cc'd procurement@emeraldai.com)

Next steps / proposed dates:
- Please confirm data share option by Friday, May 14
- Target POC kickoff: Tuesday, May 18 (if procurement completes)
- We'll send a short SOW for signature via DocuSign once you confirm scope

Attached: EmeraldAI_POC_Proposal_v1.pdf (one-pager)
Doc (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2bPoCProposal-emeraldai

Appreciate a quick thumbs-up on the success criteria and kickoff date so we can lock resources.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Recap + Proposed 4-week POC sprint & OKR-focused success criteria — EmeraldAI

Mina — thanks for the clear breakdown and the one-pager. Quick responses from our side: 

- We like the 4-week sprint outline and the proposed owners.
- One ask on success criteria: can we make the accuracy target intent-specific? For billing-related intents we need 85%+ NDCG@5; for generic routing 75% is acceptable.
- Latency target of 1.2s is reasonable but we'd like a plan for warm vs cold cache performance (esp. 95th tail).

Procurement note: I’m looping in procurement@emeraldai.com — they will need the SOW and a standard security questionnaire filled out before legal signs off. I attached our initial security questionnaire (redacted where appropriate).

We can confirm a sample S3 share but need to ensure PII is masked. We have a privacy-aware extract process — Priya (cc) can coordinate.

Tentative on kickoff: May 18 could work if procurement moves quickly. If not, a delayed start of May 24 is acceptable. Please include a simple line item quote for the trial (model hours + data ingress) so procurement can expedite.

Onwards,
Liam
Director, Product — Emerald AI
liam.oneill@emeraldai.com | (646) 555-0124

Attachment: EmeraldAI_Security_Q_v1.pdf
